name: file
title: File
description: One file as a thing with a name: an attachment, an upload or a download.
use: A document shown as an object: a small page with its extension, the name over a line of facts, and one control at the end. Several files are a list with file on each item.

instead.when: It is the place where files are chosen or dropped
The rows are not files, or share one surface on hairlines

platform.fallback: The page keeps four round corners and has no folded flap

classes.name: file
classes.description: The flat sheet that holds the page, the words and the control

classes.name: file-failed
classes.description: An upload that failed: the contour and file-meta take the danger ink; say the reason in file-meta

classes.name: file-sm
classes.description: One line, 32px tall like a small button and as wide as its name; the page is too small to carry the extension and a button inside is 24px, 4px in

classes.name: file-interactive
classes.description: The whole file is a link or a button: it stands raised, lifts under the pointer and sinks when pressed

classes.name: file-page
classes.description: The small page, 28 by 36, with the extension written at its foot in capitals

classes.name: file-thumb
classes.description: A picture in the page's place, when the file is one

classes.name: file-body
classes.description: The name and the line of facts under it

classes.name: file-name
classes.description: The file's name, on one line that ends in an ellipsis

classes.name: file-meta
classes.description: Size, kind, how far the upload is, or why it failed

classes.name: file-end
classes.description: The control at the end: remove, retry or download

classes.name: file-progress
classes.description: With progress on a progress element: the bar lies under the words and tints the sheet as far as the upload has come

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: A progress element without a value: a band of the tone lies across the sheet

properties.name: --file-padding
properties.description: Inset of the sheet; .375rem in a small file

properties.name: --file-radius
properties.description: Corner of the sheet; var(--radius-control) in a small file

properties.name: --file-page-width
properties.description: Width of the page; 1rem in a small file

properties.name: --file-page-height
properties.description: Height of the page; 1.25rem in a small file

properties.name: --file-fold
properties.description: Size of the folded corner; .3125rem in a small file
